result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.deselect_edges()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Remove edges from selection. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8045-L8088){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.deselect_edges(edge_ids) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Deselect edges](/assets/graphs/deselect-edges.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="A grid whose edges are labeled with their ids 1 to 7. Before: edges 1, 2, and 4 (A–B, B–C, B–E) are selected in the accent color. After deselect_edges with id 2, edge B–C returns to plain and edges 1 and 4 stay selected." width="100%"} Unmarks specified edges, removing them from the current selection set. Has no effect on edges that aren't currently selected. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [edge_ids]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of edge IDs to deselect. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Selecting every edge in a 5-edge cycle and then deselecting one leaves the other four selected: ::: {#412c65bc .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_cycle_graph(5) all_edges = graph.get_edge_ids() graph.select_edges_by_id(all_edges) graph.deselect_edges([all_edges[0]]) graph.count_selected_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 4 ``` ::: :::
